lines.text_source: The Croma you've met base all of their technology on vimana crystals.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.intent: explanation of technological basis and cultural knowledge
lines.base_translation: Os Croma que você conheceu baseiam toda sua tecnologia em cristais vimana.

lines.text_source: The electromagnetism they emit is in perfect harmony with their own bodies, allowing them to create all kinds of contraptions and gadgets that we could barely even imagine.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.intent: describing advanced capabilities and limitations of human understanding
lines.base_translation: O eletromagnetismo que emanam está em perfeita harmonia com seus próprios corpos, permitindo que criem todo tipo de engenho e dispositivo que mal conseguiríamos imaginar.
lines.risk_notes: Lore term 'vimana crystals' established in prior line; metaphorical complexity (electromagnetism/harmony/bodies) requires naturalness check to avoid awkwardness in pt-BR

lines.text_source: They seem to be a highly advanced civilisation. I think I understand why they're not seen so much in Hafin. This city isn't bad, but its advances aren't so different to our own.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.intent: comparative assessment of civilisation advancement and explanation of cultural/geographic disparity
lines.base_translation: Eles parecem ser uma civilização altamente avançada. Acho que entendo por que não se veem muito em Hafin. A cidade não é ruim, mas seus avanços tecnológicos não são tão diferentes dos nossos.
lines.risk_notes: Glossary term 'Hafin City' preserved as 'Hafin'; comparative reasoning about civilisation levels requires clarity in pt-BR to maintain logical flow; 'advances' (noun/verb) disambiguated as technological development
